research_question: Following an unexpected mid-mission UAV loss, how do continuous online replanning, evidence-guided replanning, and fault-triggered geometric repartitioning differ in their use of the remaining fleet and mission budget?
resource_interpretation: C7 controls the total movement resource (200 km), not a fixed mission duration; after failure 4 UAVs may consume the remaining 100 km, so failed missions run longer in clock steps than k=0. Primary robustness endpoint: retention_Pdet; RMST-vs-k=0 (degradation_NRMST) reported with caution; failure-arm pairwise comparisons share 4 survivors and the same remaining budget.

failure.definition: B_fail=0.5*B_total; trigger at end of the first timestep whose completed fleet movement distance >= B_fail; single event per run; k=2 simultaneous only (C7D)
failure.identity_rule: C4 frozen ids for (dataset,seed,k) in DS1/5/10 x 42..51; else SeedSequence([dataset,seed,k,hash(c7-failure-identity)]) choice(5,k,replace=False)

uav_roles.failed: lost: no move, no sensing, no reservations, no budget
uav_roles.search_inactive: survivor with no remaining coverage task (hold policy): no movement AND no new exposures after the final observation; assigned by pizza_replan when tasks < survivors after mandatory splitting AND when a pizza_replan survivor finishes its assigned post-fault task (it senses the final waypoint ONCE before hold; no parked repetitions; T19)

c7b.pizza_fixed_excluded_reason: no coherent pre-fault Pizza path exists after an online_static prefix; pizza_fixed remains an end-to-end (C7A) diagnostic only
c7b.shadow_belief_capture: the prefix sim's own EvidenceBelief (updated by _update_observations each timestep; online_static plans on the prior anyway); verified by T16 (num_updates == (T_f+1)*num_drones and replay-equivalence)
c7b.endpoint_basis: prefix history + post-fault branch history (concatenated trajectories); Pdet_at_fault from prefix only (identical across branches)

pizza_replan.tail_trim: remove fully-observed prefix/suffix waypoints; keep interior covered segments (physical continuity)
pizza_replan.split: split ONLY when it yields two children >= 20 m each (splittable parent ~40 m; children never below 20 m); when no splittable route remains and tasks < survivors, leftover survivors are search-inactive (no move, no sensing); finish -> final observation -> hold (pending promotion after the sensing block; T19)
pizza_replan.assignment: Hungarian (rectangular: also chooses which survivors receive a task when tasks < survivors) + deterministic lexicographic tie-break; orientation min-entry (forward/reverse); unassigned survivors search-inactive
pizza_replan.deadhead: physical transit to entry waypoint; counts fully in budget; sensor on during transit

horizon_rule: single frozen rule: within one job (dataset, seed, condition), every row (failure arms, k=0 arms, C7B prefix and branches) shares T_common = max(T) over the job rows; all RMST values in any paired comparison are evaluated at that same T_common (H_common = T_common+1); NRMST = RMST/H_common; dRMST_rel = (RMST_control - RMST_method)/H_common, positive = favorable to the method (lower RMST is better; same sign convention as dPdet); enforced by automated check common_horizon_ok

baselines.policy: ALL no-failure (k=0) baselines are computed within C7 from the same frozen C7 implementation: dynamic, online_static, random, pizza (shared by pizza_replan and pizza_fixed); frozen C5/C6 rows are used exclusively as an informational distance audit (C7_K0_FROZEN_CONSISTENCY.json), never as metric inputs and never as a gate

statistics.method: per-dataset paired means -> cluster bootstrap (seed 20260826, 10000 iters) over dataset means

status.c7d: supplementary, executed last and only if c7-midflight/c7-state-matched/c7-timing technical gates are green

scenario_mapping.C7_SYSTEM_PERFORMANCE_UNDER_MIDMISSION_L: C7A P1: cls(dPdet)==IMPROVED and cls(dRMST_rel) not in {WORSENED}
scenario_mapping.C7_ONLINE_PERFORMANCE_UNDER_MIDMISSION_L: C7A P2: cls(dPdet)==IMPROVED and cls(dRMST_rel) not in {WORSENED}
scenario_mapping.C7_EVIDENCE_PERFORMANCE_UNDER_MIDMISSION: C7A P3: cls(dPdet)==IMPROVED and cls(dRMST_rel) not in {WORSENED}
scenario_mapping.C7_SYSTEM_RECOVERY_ADVANTAGE: C7B P1B: cls(dPostFaultGain)==IMPROVED and cls(dPdet) not in {WORSENED}
scenario_mapping.C7_ONLINE_REPLANNING_RECOVERY_ADVANTAGE: C7B P2B: cls(dPostFaultGain)==IMPROVED and cls(dPdet) not in {WORSENED}
scenario_mapping.C7_EVIDENCE_RECOVERY_ADVANTAGE: C7B P3B: cls(dPostFaultGain)==IMPROVED and cls(dRMST_rel) not in {WORSENED} and mean(CondGain_dyn)-mean(CondGain_os)>0
scenario_mapping.C7_GEOMETRIC_RECOVERY_COMPETITIVE: C7B P2B: cls(dPostFaultGain) != IMPROVED (includes WORSENED: pizza significantly better)
scenario_mapping.C7_BOUNDARY: sign(global mean C7A P1.dPdet at 0.25) != sign at 0.75 OR >= 2/3 C7C datasets flip per-dataset sign (DS1/5/10)

position_policy: ALL C7 arms (failure and k=0, greedy/random and pizza) start from the SAME grid-aligned initial positions (frozen C4 pattern), so within-trial positions are identical across every method (fairness checks same_positions_across_failure_arms and same_positions_as_own_k0, both required). The legacy C5/C6 k=0 rows used raw positions, so the C7 k=0 rows are NOT expected to reproduce them within 1e-12: the C7_K0_FROZEN_CONSISTENCY audit is therefore informational (recorded, never a gate).

retention_definitions.retention_Pdet: P_detect_failure / P_detect_no_failure (from the C7 k=0 row of the same trial; 'none' if baseline P_detect <= 0)
retention_definitions.degradation_NRMST: NRMST_failure - NRMST_no_failure (same-job horizon via the common-horizon rule); reported with caution (budget-vs-time note)

time_matched.rationale: budget-matched view alone may not discriminate: with a fixed 200 km movement budget the 4 survivors can consume the same remaining distance as the full fleet, so retention tends to ~1; T_ref adds the time-matched view: how much performance remains within the operational time of a nominal 5-UAV mission
time_matched.derivation: 5 UAVs x 5 m/s consume the 200 km budget in ~8000 s at nominal; a single COMMON PHYSICAL horizon for every method (not per-method k=0 horizons)
time_matched.evaluation: per-drone paths truncated to positions [0..T_ref]; RMST evaluated at the fixed horizon T_ref; secondary (primary endpoints and scenario flags unchanged)

t5_scope: T5 regression: the pizza_replan replan at mission start (zero coverage) is compared against the REAL frozen C4 pipeline (audit_block_c._pizza_paths): identical sector multiset, and aggregate coverage equal within documented sector-entry phase noise (<=1e-4 P_detect, <=0.01 RMST; the C7 and C4 assignment rules differ by design, so per-drone paths may permute); plus an exact element-wise regression at identical assignment
